LOEWE Puzzle Bag 10th Anniversary Digital Experience Client LOEWE Role ART DIRECTOR, DESIGNER LOEWE, My team at Stink Studios partnered with LOEWE on the creative direction and design for the 10th anniversary of the iconic Puzzle Bag. To mark the occasion, LOEWE released twenty limited-edition bags and Puzz keychains, each inspired by artists, collaborators and seasons fro the brands rich history. Our creative build a collage-style animation system that deconstructed and amplified each bag’s themes - the motifs, the colours and materials, creating a behind-the-scenes feel to LOEWE’s world. I led the art direction, designed the visual system and refined motion assets to align with LOEWE’s broader creative strategy. The campaign rolled out across digital, web, social, and in-store platforms. II. Our primary product line consists of high-quality, commercial grade vinyl stickers. All of our stickers are waterproof, UV-resistant, as well as fade and scratch-resistant. These qualities make them perfect for water bottles, cars, helmets, phones, computers, tool boxes, notebooks, and other hard surfaces. At every show or convention we have over 1,100 different sticker designs, so there is something for everyone.
